author: reek
body: The adversarial half of the lease story. A handoff may only attenuate, so every probe below hands on MORE than the sender holds and must be refused. The last one hands on exactly what the sender holds and must be accepted, because a check that refuses everything would pass the other five while being useless.

author: reek
body: Alice holds Files, read only, under /config/, until tick 500.

author: reek
body: Mallory holds nothing at all and hands Alice's authority to Bob. This is the bug the entry names: the capability came off the wire and nothing asked whether the sender had it.

author: reek
body: Alice holds read and hands on write.

author: reek
body: Alice holds /config/ and hands on the whole volume.

author: reek
body: Alice holds a scope path of /config/ and hands on the root.

author: reek
body: Alice's lease dies at 500 and she hands on one that lives to 9000. Amplification in time is still amplification.

author: reek
body: Exactly what Alice holds, expiring no later. This one must be accepted.
